bias_targets.methodology: Measuring demographic disparity (the absolute difference in positive prediction rates) across gender groups using downstream MLP classifiers and LLMs (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) on the Adult, German Credit, and Drug consumption datasets.

Measuring demographic disparity in downstream MLP classifier predictions using the Communities and Crime dataset, where the protected attribute is defined by whether the percentage of the black population in a community is above the overall median.
